verdict.rationale: Sill does have a log, opened from Show Log… or the Library/Logs folder on the Mac. Nothing documents that this log records which device or person connected to which Mac and when, or that it is meant for audit export. It reads as a troubleshooting log, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for a connection-audit story. The paired-devices list in Settings › Devices shows which devices may connect, not a history of sessions.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can see a log of who connected to which machine and when, exportable for audit

citations.quote: On your Mac, choose Show Log… in the Sill menu, or open the Sill folder in Library/Logs in your home folder.
